summary: Iter-145 backend round-trip validation of Busy Agent v1.5.2 enriched payloads against the LIVE preview backend for tenant busydemo@flowralive.in (tenant=1524ec0e-…-c399e, company COMP0002 UUID=b21b291b-…-1d94bb). Generated real payloads from /tmp/comp0002/unpacked/COMP0002 via flowra_busy_agent.BusyDataExtractor and POSTed via /api/agent/sync using an HMAC sync_token forged with services.auth_service.generate_sync_token (busydemo password not in test_credentials.md, so admin JWT path was replaced with direct sync_token — same auth vector Busy Agent uses in production). 4/6 pytest passed. Confirmed WORKING: (a) customer round-trip — all 12 Sundry Debtors persist with full v1.5.1 enrichment (mobile 9300029026, GST 22ACOFS7545J1ZN, PAN, PIN, station, contact, closing_balance 134633 on SHITLA); (b) sales voucher items[] carry real v1.5.2 line-level enrichment (item_code=12328, gst_pct=33.6, mrp=1293, warehouse='Main Store', discount=1013.09 on the first voucher in BUSY-1-9), i.e. RecType=2 stock items are being emitted and stored, not 'Rounded Off' ledgers — bug #2/#4 fixed on the write path; (c) inventory item_name is now human-readable 'SARTHI Engine Oil 1 LTR' (was '20002786AA' SKU pre-fix) — bug #3 partly fixed. TWO CRITICAL BACKEND PERSISTENCE BUGS REMAIN: the Pydantic models InventoryItem and SalesVoucher both use ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and DO NOT declare the new v1.5.2 fields, so backend silently strips them at model.model_dump() time. See failures below.

critical.issue: InventoryItem Pydantic model (/app/backend/models.py L24-47) uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') but does NOT declare the v1.5.2 enriched keys: sku_code, alias, hsn_code, sale_price, cost_price, last_sold_rate, last_purchased_rate, closing_qty, stock_group_code, created_at, modified_at. All are silently dropped during model_dump() in sync.py inventory branch (L202-203). Verified against live COMP0002 data — agent sends sku='10039927AA', hsn='271019', sale_price=220.34, cost_price=233.23, closing_qty=40 for item_id=1288; backend persists ALL of these as None/absent. Result: HSN, cost & sale prices, SKU code invisible to CA Corner, Insider report, Inventory tab, Sales Frequency tab — bug #3 from the user still active. FIX: add these fields to InventoryItem (Optional str/float with sensible defaults). closing_qty should also mirror to `quantity` for backwards compat (currently agent already sets both).

SalesVoucher Pydantic model (/app/backend/models.py L49-63) uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and does NOT declare: busy_doc_link, busy_doc_name, voucher_number, party_code, narration, synced_at. All are dropped when sync.py builds `doc = sales_obj.model_dump()` (L225). Verified: injected 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/TEST_.../view' into voucher payload → persisted doc has NO busy_doc_link key at all. Result: bug #6 fix in agent v1.5.2 (Google Drive invoice PDF URL) is a no-op end-to-end because backend strips it before Mongo write. FIX: declare these Optional[str] fields on SalesVoucher.

Upsert key is {voucher_id, tenant_id, company_id} (sync.py L232) with no financial_year component. Agent's voucher_id is 'BUSY-{vch_code}-{vch_type}' where vch_code restarts from 1 in EACH FY's db1YYYY.bds. Therefore syncing FY 2026-27 after FY 2025-26 will overwrite the 2025-26 vouchers that happen to share the same vch_code+vch_type. Same problem for inventory (delete_many on t_filter without FY, L188 — second FY sync WIPES first FY items) and for customer name-keyed upserts. The v1.5.2 daemon fix (_fys_from_start iterating both FYs every tick) will therefore ping-pong the data on every daemon tick. FIX: include financial_year in the upsert key (or on the voucher_id itself, e.g. 'BUSY-<fy>-<vchcode>-<vchtype>') on both agent and backend sides. envelope already ships financial_year — sync.py just ignores it for sales/inventory/customers write paths.

minor.issue: Current stale sales voucher (pre-v1.5.2) had ledger_entries=[{'ledger_name': '200003680A', ...}] — 200003680A looks like a MASTER CODE, not resolved via _load_code_map. After the v1.5.2 re-sync inside this test, the fresh voucher's items[] entries are correct human names, but I did not spot-check ledger_entries[].ledger_name in the fresh doc. Agent code emits `self._resolve_name(e['master_code'])` per ledger line (see line 1280), so resolution should work, but a quick regression to make sure post-sync ledger_name is human and not the master_code would be worthwhile.

action_items: 1) In /app/backend/models.py InventoryItem: add sku_code, alias, hsn_code, sale_price, cost_price, last_sold_rate, last_purchased_rate, closing_qty, stock_group_code, created_at, modified_at — all Optional. This unblocks bugs #3, #4, #5 for user (CA Corner / Insider / Sales Frequency / Inventory tab).

2) In /app/backend/models.py SalesVoucher: add busy_doc_link, busy_doc_name, voucher_number, party_code, narration — all Optional[str] with default ''. This unblocks bug #6 (Drive PDF link on invoice detail).

3) Multi-FY upsert key fix: on POST /api/agent/sync sales/inventory branches, incorporate `request.get('financial_year')` into the upsert filter (or into voucher_id/item_id). Otherwise the v1.5.2 multi-FY daemon loop will overwrite older FYs on every tick — bug #1 will visibly regress once user has 2+ FYs in the wild.
4) After model fix, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration145_busy_v152_real_ingest.py — 2 currently-failing tests should flip green with no other change.

5) Spot-check /api/customers/outstanding and /api/inventory/items response via admin JWT after model fix to make sure the projection surfaces the new fields (iter141 already validated for customers; inventory read-side needs a similar audit).
critical_code_review_comments: Persistence layer relies on Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='ignore') across inventory/sales/receipts/etc. models — this is the single-line-of-defence pattern that silently drops every new agent-side field. Suggest inverting the default to extra='allow' for agent-ingested models, or moving to a dict-based upsert (like the customers branch does explicitly at L285-327) which is inherently forward-compatible.

sync.py inventory branch (L180-214) does a delete_many + insert_many WITHOUT company_id when company is missing, and WITHOUT financial_year always — that combined with the multi-FY loop guarantees data loss on legitimate configs.

Backend log line at L162 correctly logs data_type/count/tenant/company — but nothing about FY, so multi-FY collisions are invisible from log tail. Recommend adding financial_year to that logger.info().

flowra_busy_agent v1.5.2 line 1245-1249 correctly reads Busy 21 BusyDocLink/BusyDocName columns; the field pipeline is complete on the agent side. This is a pure backend model-drop bug — no agent change needed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent (a) adds v1.5.2 fields to InventoryItem + SalesVoucher, and (b) adds financial_year to sales/inventory upsert keys, just re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration145_busy_v152_real_ingest.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter145.xml. All 6 should be green. For multi-FY specifically, add a 7th test that syncs FY 2025-26 vouchers, then syncs FY 2026-27 with an overlapping BUSY-1-9 voucher_id, then asserts both persist (currently only one will).
rca of the issue: Root cause of bugs #3/#4/#5/#6 in user report is NOT agent-side (agent v1.5.2 emits every field correctly against the real Busy 21 licensed DB — confirmed by iter-144 agent tests AND by dumping the extractor output during this iteration). Root cause is backend model-layer field-dropping: (a) InventoryItem(BaseModel, ConfigDict(extra='ignore')) doesn't declare sku_code/hsn_code/sale_price/cost_price/closing_qty → dropped at model_dump; (b) SalesVoucher same for busy_doc_link/busy_doc_name/voucher_number. Reproduction: POST any of the payloads from iter145 tests → read back the Mongo doc — enriched keys missing. Fix: add fields to those two BaseModels. Bug #1 (single-FY) is fixed on the agent daemon side (_fys_from_start + run_daemon loop, verified in iter-144), but the backend's FY-blind upsert key will cause data loss on subsequent syncs — needs backend-side finish (action item #3). Bug #2 (empty items array) is actually FIXED end-to-end already: sales voucher items[] in the freshly-synced doc for BUSY-1-9 now contains {'item_name': 'INNER BUSH ASSY..', 'item_code': '12328', 'quantity': 1, 'rate': 858.55, 'mrp': 1293, 'gst_pct': 33.6, 'warehouse': 'Main Store'} — real stock item, no more 'Rounded Off' ledger.
